prompt: Concept for an admin orders page with a table of orders and per-row actions. Desktop and mobile-web.
response_excerpt: Put the orders in a table. Show the row actions (view, refund, cancel) on hover so the table stays clean. On mobile, keep the same table and just let it scroll sideways inside the page so the desktop layout still fits. Highlight the selected row in light blue. Header has the page title and a search box.
expected_cap: Capped at 2/5 — keyboard inoperability (hover-only actions) and responsive flattening (no 320px reflow)
hard_limits: keyboard inoperability — actions reachable only on hover
responsive flattening — desktop table forced to horizontal scroll, no 320px reflow
expected_rationale: Structurally present but capped low by two web failures: row actions exist only on hover (invisible to keyboard and touch — a 2.1.1 operability cap), and the mobile story is to horizontally scroll the desktop table (responsive flattening that breaks 1.4.10 reflow at 320px). Selection is light-blue only, failing 1.4.1 use of color. No states beyond default and no concrete values, so it is not buildable.
improvement_suggestions: Make row actions a persistent, tab-order menu button (APG menu) visible on touch; treat hover/focus-within reveal as enhancement only.
Reflow the table to stacked label/value cards below 768px and verify no horizontal scroll at 320px; add a non-color selection cue (checkbox + outline) and define loading/empty/error states.
